data.name: Yuvaan
data.gender_notes: Yuvaan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Yuvaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'yuva', meaning 'youth'. This name is often used for newborn baby boys. It evokes a sense of vibrancy, energy, and freshness, reflecting the spirit of the young one. The name Yuvaan carries the meaning “Youth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Yuvaan usually hope their child will grow to embody youth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Yuvaan holds spiritual significance in Hinduism, as it is associated with Lord Ganesha, the elephant-headed god who represents new beginnings and the removal of obstacles. By naming a child Yuvaan, parents may hope to imbue them with the qualities of wisdom, strength, and good fortune.
data.etymology: Yuvaan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Youth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yuvaan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
